conversation.message: It’s been really upsetting since my baby was born about ten weeks ago. I keep getting unwanted, intrusive images of her being harmed, and I find them horrifying. It’s mostly at home, especially when I’m looking after her, and I’ve been avoiding bathing her alone and checking on her a lot during the night.
